request: Our school library wants a simple catalogue of its books. The librarian should be able to add a book with its title, its author and how many copies the library owns. Students should be able to see all the books, and look at one book to see how many copies are still on the shelf. A student borrows a book by giving their name, and returns it when they are done; a student can only return a book they actually borrowed. When every copy of a book is out, nobody else can borrow it until a copy comes back.

## Summary

I've built a complete FastAPI application for the school library book catalogue system with the following endpoints:

### Book Management (for the librarian)
- **GET `/`** - Returns welcome message
- **GET `/books`** - Lists all books in the library
- **GET `/books/{book_id}`** - Gets details of a specific book including copies on shelf
- **POST `/books`** - Adds a new book (requires: title, author, total_copies)
- **PUT `/books/{book_id}`** - Updates a book's information
- **DELETE `/books/{book_id}`** - Deletes a book from the catalogue

### Borrowing/Returning (for students)
- **POST `/borrow`** - A student borrows a book by providing their name
  - Returns the first available book
  - Blocks borrowing if all copies are out
- **POST `/return`** - A student returns a borrowed book
  - Student can only return books they borrowed
- **GET `/borrowing/status/{student_name}`** - Shows what books a student currently has borrowed

### Features
- SQLite database with tables created automatically on startup
- Each book tracks total copies and available copies
- Borrowing records track which student borrowed which book
- Students can only return books they actually borrowed
- No new borrowing is allowed when all copies of a book are out
